name: Ignored tests
description: Tests skipped or disabled on purpose. Check the @Disabled reason or the assumption that skipped the test, and re-enable it if the blocker is gone.

name: Visual regression mismatch (layout changed)
description: The page screenshot differs from the stored baseline. Compare the actual, expected and diff images in the report; if the change is intended, regenerate the baseline in Docker so fonts and rendering match CI.

name: Product defects (assertion failed)
description: An assertion did not hold, so the application behaved differently than expected. Compare the expected and actual values in the message and confirm whether it is a real defect or an outdated expectation.

name: Ambiguous locator (strict mode violation)
description: A locator matched several elements while exactly one was required. Scope or narrow the locator (parent container, role name, nth or filter) so it resolves to a single element.

name: Navigation / network problems
description: The page or browser could not load a URL, or it was closed mid-test. Check the base URL, DNS and connectivity, and whether the site blocks automated traffic; also look for a test closing the page or context too early.
messageRegex: (?s).*(net::ERR|NS_ERROR_|Page closed|Target closed|Target page, context or browser has been closed|Navigation failed).*

name: Element not found / timeout waiting for action
description: Playwright timed out waiting for an element or action. Read the call log in the message: the locator may be wrong, the element hidden, covered or disabled, or the page too slow; fix the locator or wait condition before raising timeouts.

name: Test infrastructure problems
description: Any other broken test, usually an unexpected exception in setup, teardown or test code rather than a product issue. Check the stack trace for configuration, browser launch or resource problems.
